event_summary: A small brown round object crosses the tabletop from left to right beneath a stationary white textured block and exits the frame.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a light wood-grain tabletop, a white textured rectangular block near the upper center, and a dark round object at the far left edge. After several still frames, a small brown round object enters from the left side, travels rightward across the tabletop below the white block, shows motion blur and changing visible orientation, then exits at the right edge. The white block and the dark left-edge object remain visibly stationary throughout.

reasons: The tabletop and white block are fully visible before the moving brown object appears.
The dark object at the far left edge is partially visible.
No scene-object motion is visible in the first frame.
